The thesis

Not a virtual pet. A rehearsal.

What this isn't

Tamagotchi, Nintendogs, and every cute-pet app share one trait: nothing you do costs you anything real, and you can ignore the thing for a week with no consequence. That's entertainment — it teaches you nothing about whether you can actually do this.

What this is

A rehearsal for real ownership. The walks happen in real time and require you to actually leave the house. The feeding windows are real clock hours. If you say "I'm at work for 9 hours," you come home to exactly what a puppy does to a flat in 9 hours — good or bad.

How It Works

It's simple. But it's real.

Choose a breed, name your dog, and live the next 30 days together. Feed and walk on the real clock, train real skills with video demos and situational quizzes, leave for work and declare your hours, and see exactly what happened when you get back — good or bad.

Real Breeds. Real Differences.

Every dog has a different life.

A Husky needs more exercise. A French Bulldog needs more care. Each breed comes with its own energy, needs and challenges — choose the one that fits your lifestyle, or realize it doesn't.

Belgian Malinois10/109/103hWorking-line intensity that needs a real job — daily obedience or sport, or that drive turns into problems.
